title: ‘Dapat 1sa Lang’ digital platform gathering signatures vs political dynasties
summary: Various civil society groups, religious, and grassroots organizations launched Wednesday digital signature platform “Dapat 1sa Lang” to push for an Anti-Dynasty Law through a people's initiative.
